title: Unit Event — The Way I Played That Day — Episode3 What Music Is To Me

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day
meta.Episode: Episode3 — What Music Is To Me
meta.Event Outline: Kanade continues to write songs in the hope of saving Mafuyu. When her grandmother calls to suggest that she think more about herself and her own future, her thoughts turn toward the past.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hnng... It's three in the morning already? I might go to bed...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I want to keep working until morning, but I was told that I need to be at school tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, Enanan, if you really wanna go to art school, shouldn't you start working on being able to wake up in the morning?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha! Anyway, I'm gonna log off.
Night, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I think I'm at a good place to stop, so I'm also going to log off. I'll send over what I have now...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Then, I'll go take a bath.
I am starting to get a little sleepy.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need to finish this by morning...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <I'm sorry. I know I'm throwing a tough question at you...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <But I hope you'll give it some thought when you get a chance... This is your future we're talking about.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I also think you should take more time to do the things that you want, K. The things you think are fun.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(The things I want to do...
The things I think are fun....)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I did have fun that one time when I was little...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I wanted to compose warm and soothing songs like the ones Dad did...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I composed those songs because I liked his so much.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Now I've only ever been able to focus on what I have to do...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I'm not really sure...
But I think it's something more than what I need to do...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm having trouble focusing now, so I should probably take a break...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Mafuyu was able to start moving forward because she fought back against her mom that day...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (And that has caused things to change in this SEKAI. This new area appearing is proof of that.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What is it? What do you want...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm here for something else, not you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You brought your sketchbook...?
Are you going to draw something?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I promised Ena that I'd do a drawing of the lake for her.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You don't have to.
You're not in the way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Actually, I could include you in my drawing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's Kanade. Do you think something happened to her?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, KAITO, aren't you gonna go see her with me...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't need to if you're going.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (She's trying to compose a song that'll save Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But I don't know why she is or what's driving her to do so.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll go have a quick look...
